jobs.impact: Statements that must land, hero words. Ration: max ~1 per 8-10s or they stop hitting.
jobs.whoosh: Every zoom-in and every fast move. Peak on the frame the motion is fastest.
jobs.shutter: Section changes and fast montages only. Never on same-thought jump cuts (ep #2 rule).
jobs.click: Anything appears. Same pairing every time (conditioned reward). Alternate button_1/2 so repeats stay fresh.
jobs.typing: Kinetic type: one quiet tap per word/chunk; captions: one very quiet tap per new line.
jobs.ios: LOCKED: real Apple sounds 1:1 for every iOS UI graphic.
jobs.reveal: Reveals, secrets, gold words lighting up.
jobs.build: Under a build-up; the END/peak lands on the payoff word.
